runSummary.stalePolicy: Only offers verified within the last 48 hours are eligible for LIVE display.
runSummary.note: Full diversity sweep on 8.9.2026 16:50 CEST. No new unique promotion-grade item passed ranking and evidence gates. LinkedIn produced Bratislava support candidates, but Sharp Brains requires 1–3 years desktop support plus Active Directory/networking, Global Blue is L2/L3 with PowerShell/SQL/Splunk and strong English, and Wolt requires student eligibility plus English B2. Worki returned an e-shop admin match that is explicitly filled/cancelled. Existing 50 LIVE items are preserved fail-closed.

sources.name: Priame firemné career stránky
sources.note: Reálne preverené priame careers pre Bratislavu/remote. Hemmersbach verejný career index poskytol iba proactive application, nie konkrétnu novú BA rolu vhodnú na promotion.

sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs
sources.note: Verejný index reálne vyhľadaný. Sharp Brains DSS L1 je onsite Bratislava/B2B, ale žiada 1–3 roky desktop supportu, Active Directory a sieťové základy. Global Blue Application Support je L2/L3 s PowerShell/SQL/Splunk, Windows Server a strong English. Wolt part-time support vyžaduje študentský status a English B2. Nexcess vyžaduje Linux/terminal/networking. Coverage bez loginu zostáva čiastočná.

sources.note: Reálne preverené BA/remote admin, support a e-shop výsledky. Shield-Sk Administrátor e-shopu / zákaznícka podpora v Ružinove je obsahovo veľmi relevantný, ale detail explicitne uvádza, že miesto už bolo obsadené alebo zrušené.

sources.name: Kariera.sk / Zoznam / ÚPSVR mirror

sources.name: Pretlak / StartupJobs / WordPress Jobs
